prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: reusable mascot roster for the TOKKATSU Hiroba Japanese school activities website.
Input image: the existing approved pixel-art sheet. The UPPER FOUR CHARACTERS are the strict identity and style reference; do not include the lower school panorama.
Primary request: refine those same four ORIGINAL human-shaped pixel mascots into a consistent, carefully authored sprite family. Keep their friendly slightly rugged school-website character. This is a modest refinement of the reference, NOT a new style. 16-bit pixel illustration, clean deliberate square pixel clusters, medium-fine pixels and readable faces. Flat colors, solid dark outlines of uniform pixel thickness, at most two tones per material. No gradients, texture grain, gloss, 3D, smooth vector edges, shadows on ground, atmospheric effects or AI decorative noise.
Composition: one horizontal sheet about 3:1 aspect ratio, four equally wide cells in one row, all four full bodies visible, no overlap across cells, consistent scale and baseline. Transparent background, genuine alpha, no checkerboard painted into art. Each character occupies about 70% of its cell width and 80% image height, all flags/capes/hands inside their cell. No words or labels.
Character proportions: all about 2.1 heads tall, big heads, little solid bodies, mitten-simple skin-colored hands, small white shoes, warm peach faces with two simple black vertical eyes, small smiling mouth and tiny red-orange cheeks. The SAME eye style and outline weight for everyone. No blue eyes, bulbous noses, white gloves or trademark franchise motifs.
Left to right preserve exactly:
1 Green 学活くん: dark green tunic and shorts, single short cream vertical placket at neck, short neatly side-parted dark hair, holds a small white rectangular note card with two green lines in right side of image; left hand raised in friendly greeting. Calm welcoming smile.
2 Orange 行人: orange-red tunic with one horizontal white stripe, orange shorts, white headband with small knot/tails, short dark hair; holds one yellow triangular flag upright on right side of image, one leg slightly lifted. Energetic open smile.
3 Blue 児童会ちゃん: dark hair with TWO low rounded side hair buns, royal blue A-line tunic, golden yellow sash from upper left to lower right in image, holds a small gray handheld microphone on right, left hand open in welcoming invitation. Gentle smile.
4 Yellow クラブマン: sunny yellow tunic and shorts, simple WHITE five-point star with dark outline centered on chest, blue headband, short orange-red cape. Both arms bent upward in cheerful celebration. Small open smile.
Keep pixel stair steps intentional and tidy, no isolated random speckles, no unnecessary hair strands, no fingers detail. One black-brown outline color shared across all 4. Recognizable at small web card sizes. Match the reference's sturdy, familiar, unpretentious charm closely.
